column1: # Cases where the decoder of this crate does not read a probe as Saxon-HE 12.10 and xmllint
# both do in the reference environment of expected.tsv (libxml2 2.9.14 built with iconv and
# ICU, on Ubuntu 24.04; Java 21), with the reason: the reference parsers disagree and the
# decoder refuses the document, or both read it in an encoding the decoder does not read.
# tests/encoding.rs fails on any other difference and on any listed case that no longer differs.

column2: reason
A UTF-16 byte order mark and a declaration naming UTF-8: xmllint reads UTF-16, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::EncodingMismatch).
As utf16le/bom-decl-utf-8.
As utf16le/bom-decl-utf-8, without a byte order mark (the first bytes are `<?` in UTF-16).
As utf16le/no-bom-decl-utf-8.

ISO-10646-UCS-2 after a UTF-16 byte order mark: both read this short document as UTF-16, but not the longer ones: xmllint looks the name up in ICU (iconv does not know it) and decodes what follows its first reads of the file with that converter, refusing the document in little-endian (utf16le/bom-decl-ucs-2-long) and dropping the characters split across two reads in big-endian (utf16be/bom-decl-ucs-2-long), where Saxon-HE reads UTF-16. Refused as unsupported.
As utf16le/bom-decl-ucs-2.
As utf16le/bom-decl-ucs-2, without a byte order mark (the first bytes are `<?` in UTF-16).
As utf16le/no-bom-decl-ucs-2.

ISO-10646-UCS-2 in UTF-16LE, a document longer than the first reads of xmllint: xmllint refuses it, Saxon-HE reads it as UTF-16 (utf16le/bom-decl-utf-16-long: both do under the name UTF-16). Refused as unsupported.
As utf16le/bom-decl-ucs-2-long, without a byte order mark.

ISO-10646-UCS-2 in UTF-16BE, a document longer than the first reads of xmllint: xmllint drops two of the six characters split across two of its reads, Saxon-HE reads them all (utf16be/bom-decl-utf-16-long: both do under the name UTF-16). Refused as unsupported.
As utf16be/bom-decl-ucs-2-long, without a byte order mark.

The name UCS-2 after a UTF-16LE byte order mark: xmllint reads it (iconv knows UCS-2), Saxon-HE refuses it; after a UTF-16BE byte order mark, both refuse it (utf16be/bom-decl-ucs-2-short). Refused as unsupported.
The name UTF16 after a UTF-16LE byte order mark: xmllint reads it, Saxon-HE refuses it. Refused as unsupported.
The name UTF16 after a UTF-16BE byte order mark: both read it, but not in the other byte order (utf16le/bom-decl-utf16-no-dash), so the name is not one the decoder accepts. Refused as unsupported.
An unpaired high surrogate at the end of the document: xmllint ignores it, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
As utf16le/bom-high-at-end.
An odd number of bytes, the last one after the document element: xmllint ignores it, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
As utf16le/bom-odd-length.
A name of UTF-8 that xmllint accepts through ICU (which ignores case, `-` and `_` in names) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
Shift_JIS, read by both: an encoding the decoder does not read. Refused as unsupported.
As utf8/bom-decl-Shift_JIS-ascii (both read the bytes after the UTF-8 byte order mark as Shift_JIS).
A name of ISO-8859-1 that xmllint accepts (one of the names libxml2 knows itself) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A name of ISO-8859-15 that xmllint accepts (iconv) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A name of ISO-8859-15 that Saxon-HE accepts and xmllint does not support (neither iconv nor ICU knows it). Refused as unsupported.
A name of windows-1252 that xmllint accepts (iconv) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A name of windows-1252 that xmllint accepts through ICU and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
As cp1252/name-06-x-cp1252.
A byte that is no character in windows-1252: Saxon-HE reads U+FFFD in its place, xmllint refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
As cp1252/byte-81.
